newsitem.title: USA: Budd, Tallent to build chassis plant in Kentucky.
newsitem.headline: Budd, Tallent to build chassis plant in Kentucky.

text.p: Budd Co, a unit of Thyssen Industrie AG, and Tallent Engineering Ltd said Tuesday they will build a new automotive manufacturing plant on about 50 acres in Hopkinsville, Ky., about 50 miles north of Nashville, Tenn.
They said the initial investment will be nearly $50 million, with employment projected to be 250.
The facility is expected to be up and running in 1998.
Tallent Engineering, of Newton Aycliffe, England, develops chassis structural and suspension products. Budd produces components such as doors, fenders, roofs and hoods.
